citations.claim: At step 122 EW was green (preempted direction) before emergency started
At step 123 EW shows yellow with emergency active, only 1s of yellow before switch
At step 124 NS turned green after 0s all-red, violating clearance; first violating step

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event; otherwise identical. Without preemption the cycle keeps full yellow and all-red, so no violation.

explanation: Emergency preemption forces an immediate switch to the emergency direction: EW went from green at step 122 to yellow at step 123 to NS green at step 124, giving only 1s yellow (need 6) and 0s all-red (need 2). Removing the emergency removes the failure, confirming preemption skips clearance/yellow.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: Steps 121-122 show green for one direction with the cross direction held at red, and step 123 switches the green direction to yellow. Step 124 then already shows green for the opposite direction with no all-red step where all approaches are red in between.
